parameters.formDescription: Upload one PDF, JPEG or PNG (maximum 20 MiB). This step stores the original only. OCR and review are not connected yet. Use a new Upload ID for a new submission; reuse it only to retry the same file.

parameters.content:
## Phase 01 / Step 3 — real upload intake only
Derived from Email invoice archiving & data extraction.json (2-Utility-SaveInvoices_template). Original preserved. Reuses and rewrites the short Code and HTTP Request node patterns. Gmail, Drive/SFTP, Sheets, AI extraction and deletion branches are omitted from this upload slice.

**Real:** file transfer, persistent original, receipt registration, delivery/content deduplication. **Not connected:** OCR, structured extraction, business validation, review tasks and notifications.
Internal API: http://python-api:8000. One file per submission. Upload ID is the stable retry key; use a different ID for a new receipt. No credentials required for this loopback-only demo.
